name: Parselena
source:
The young King of Aquamaris, Gilbert, consumed by his loss and guilt, left his people to deal with the consequences of a terrible war.

Enya had just begun a bright streak in her life, when suddenly the girl was kidnapped to another world. Although she managed to save herself from the kidnapper, the problems didn't end there.

Fate brought them both together in the prison of Aquamaris, where Enya was caught stealing. Although the young King doesn't know how to help the girl return home, he promises to help her at all costs.
